rows.message:
[Engine] SYCL: the prompt attention batch is budgeted where it is allocated, and stays 32 by default

The scratch of the FP32 prompt attention is batch x chunks x n_head x 258 floats (about 0.41 GB at 32 and 1.65 GB at 128 on
Flash-Next), independent of the prompt chunk.  Prefill::init allocated it from STRATA_ATTN_BATCH (128 since 09524eb47) while the
estimate that sizes the expert cache and the prompt path's loan (bytes_needed_impl) still counted 32, so about 1.2 GB was never
reserved and a single 32 GB Arc Pro B65 with the config setup writes failed its first request ("device buffers for a chunk of 512
tokens do not fit (2098 of 32656 MiB free)").  Both now use one function (attn_batch_for), and the batch is capped at the chunk's
token count, since a chunk never runs more queries than it has.

The default goes back to 32: with the budget honest, 128 would take 1.2 GB from the expert cache on every Intel card for a
1.1-1.3% faster prompt on two B65s.  STRATA_ATTN_BATCH still sets it (1..1024), and is now counted.
